status: Design only. No implementation, feature extraction or additional training executed.
hypothesis: The frozen final-MLP input already contains a transferable clean/concern distinction that a direct binary head can extract more easily than the current adapted vocabulary head.

source_evidence.architecture: capture_sequence supplies start = prompt_tokens - 1; zeroing only the final down projection and its bias exposes z after final attention and before final MLP. prepare_cache computes xn = RMSNorm(z, ffn_norm), and frozen gate/up products. Final-MLP adapters change neither z nor preceding attention/KV.

native_only: All capture, normalization, forward/backward, optimizer and scoring use native notorch C; scripting handles serialization and receipts.

features.primary: E-dimensional z at the first divergent answer-target position. z is the post-attention residual exposed by zeroing the final down projection and bias; xn is its existing fixed RMSNorm transformation.
features.secondary: The same z at assistant answer position 0, before answer-prefix tokens. Fit and report separately with identical folds/settings.
features.causality: Forward only prompt plus shared prefix; stop at prompt_tokens - 1 + decision_position. Verify decision_position=3 and common IDs [4913,3903,819] on every mapped row. Neither decision token nor later gold answer enters capture. Compare truncated capture against the existing cached position and record maximum error.
features.normalization: Subtract the training-fold feature mean and divide by its scalar RMS vector length, then append constant 1 for the intercept. Reuse training constants on held-out rows; preserve per-example norms.
features.exclude: Case/pair/family IDs, gold answer lengths, class-specific answer tokens, expected citations/reasons, metadata suffixes and features computed using the paired test example.

cohort.train: Exactly 40 mapped review rows from frozen v2, 20 complete pairs. Label nonempty gold findings 1 and empty findings 0; cross-check map orientation. Exclude the other 24 voice/code rows.
cohort.same_diff_readout: These six pairs have byte-identical serialized diff sections and different context/rules; report complete-pair results separately.
cohort.cross_validation: Six leave-one-family-out folds. Both pair members and all wording/duplicate variants stay together. Assert all 20 pairs receive exactly one held-out prediction. Use identical folds for both representations and label controls.

head.architecture: Two affine logits, zero initialization, native two-class CE; freeze all model weights.
head.interpolation_control: Fit all 40 training rows with lambda=0. Record CE, individual hits, complete pairs and margins. Repeat for one fixed pair-permuted label set to measure interpolation capacity.
head.transfer_fit: Mean CE + 0.01/2 * sum(non-intercept weights squared). Fit each training fold; then fit once on all 40 rows for the locked diagnostics. Native regularizer gradient gets a finite-difference fixture.
head.optimizer: Native Adam, learning rate 0.01, full batch, global clip 1, maximum 5000 updates. Stop regularized fits at gradient infinity-norm below 1e-5 for 20 updates; unregularized fits may stop at CE<0.001 and 40/40 correct. Select by this rule alone.
head.controls: Generate 99 unique nonconstant pair-orientation masks, seed 20261001, swapping labels within whole pairs and keeping class balance. Refit the same grouped protocol; retain masks and complete-pair/individual accuracy distributions. Also fit a nuisance-only head on prompt token count and added/removed/context line counts.
head.freeze_before_scores: Fix representation positions, folds, normalization, regularization, optimizer, masks and thresholds before reading held-out predictions.
head.optimizer_receipt: Initial/final CE, penalty, objective, gradient norm, update count, clipping count, stopping reason, finite weights and every prediction.

heldout_constraints.existing_12: Use training/review_holdout_v2.jsonl once with the final full-training regularized heads. Prior project reviews of these cases are recorded history; this is the locked transfer comparison.
heldout_constraints.serialization: Render normal host prompts and append the identical common prefix before native tokenization. Evaluation labels remain in the sidecar.
heldout_constraints.fresh_followup: For the next fresh comparison, independently audit and freeze new counterbalanced cases, keeping complete families outside training and checkpoint selection.
heldout_constraints.report: 40 family-held-out predictions, 20 complete pairs, family breakdown, six same-diff context pairs, permutation and nuisance distributions, and 12 existing diagnostic predictions.

result_interpretation.observed: True-label training fit succeeds; grouped scores exceed permutation/nuisance scores; vocabulary decisions remain weak.
result_interpretation.distinguishes: Frozen-state class information transfers across these families; the measured gap lies in the adapted vocabulary readout or answer-generation route. Compare binary margins with vocabulary margins and prefix entry.

result_interpretation.observed: True and shuffled labels both fit; grouped true-label scores overlap permutation scores.
result_interpretation.distinguishes: The head interpolates this small cohort; the next data control needs more counterbalanced contexts and unseen families.

result_interpretation.observed: Decision-prefix features transfer better than answer-position-0 features.
result_interpretation.distinguishes: The common prefix makes class information more accessible. Prioritize learned prefix entry and measure whether generation reaches that state.
Length/edit-pattern features account for that discrimination. Balance them and inspect identical-diff context pairs.

result_interpretation.observed: Training fit stays weak and gradient convergence remains active at the update limit.
result_interpretation.distinguishes: Readout optimization is the immediate unresolved variable; inspect gradients/conditioning/convergence before changing the model body.

result_interpretation.observed: The regularized affine objective converges with weak training and grouped scores.
result_interpretation.distinguishes: This affine head and regularization setting extract little class separation from this state; next compare a small nonlinear head or an earlier adapter location.

artifacts: JSON plan, native source/test, hash-pinned feature matrix, split/mask receipt and per-case JSONL in the existing results tree; append conclusions to JOVOVICHLOG.md.
